subject.title: 5.26 supervisor mode + dual-plist install: 30s EADDRINUSE loop + silent-fail unset order

question: Should OpenClaw change generated macOS launchd service behavior, doctor repair, or install/node lifecycle for this dual-plist supervisor loop, or document the operator recovery path first?
rationale: The remaining fix touches launchd supervisor marker semantics and node service lifecycle behavior, which can affect existing managed macOS installs and needs owner policy beyond a narrow docs patch.

options.title: Document recovery first
options.body: Land the open docs runbook for affected operators and keep runtime/doctor/install changes as follow-up work once macOS launchd behavior is live-proven.

options.title: Change generated wrapper/install behavior
options.body: Update launchd wrapper generation and installation defaults so new gateway installs clear inherited launchd markers, with upgrade proof for existing managed installs.

options.title: Add doctor repair only
options.body: Teach doctor to detect and offer the dual-plist repair while leaving service generation unchanged until a broader lifecycle decision is made.

recommendation.title: Document recovery first
recommendation.body: Land the open docs runbook for affected operators and keep runtime/doctor/install changes as follow-up work once macOS launchd behavior is live-proven.

likelyOwner.reason: This login has the strongest history signal across the launchd, service-env, and supervisor-marker files involved in the remaining product choice.
